Lists Accounts that the provider has access to.
Grants an approval on an Account.
Rejects an approval on an Account.
Resets an Account and cancels all associated Entitlements.
operation.description: Resets an Account and cancels all associated Entitlements. Partner can only reset accounts they own rather than customer accounts.

operation.summary: Lists Entitlements for which the provider has read access.
Approves an entitlement that is in the EntitlementState.ENTITLEMENT_ACTIVATION_REQUESTED state.
operation.description: Approves an entitlement that is in the EntitlementState.ENTITLEMENT_ACTIVATION_REQUESTED state. This method is invoked by the provider to approve the creation of the entitlement resource.

operation.summary: Approves an entitlement plan change that is in the EntitlementState.ENTITLEMENT_PENDING_PLAN_CHANGE_APPROVAL state.
operation.description: Approves an entitlement plan change that is in the EntitlementState.ENTITLEMENT_PENDING_PLAN_CHANGE_APPROVAL state. This method is invoked by the provider to approve the plan change on the entitlement resource.

operation.summary: Rejects an entitlement that is in the EntitlementState.ENTITLEMENT_ACTIVATION_REQUESTED state.
operation.description: Rejects an entitlement that is in the EntitlementState.ENTITLEMENT_ACTIVATION_REQUESTED state. This method is invoked by the provider to reject the creation of the entitlement resource.

operation.summary: Rejects an entitlement plan change that is in the EntitlementState.ENTITLEMENT_PENDING_PLAN_CHANGE_APPROVAL state.
operation.description: Rejects an entitlement plan change that is in the EntitlementState.ENTITLEMENT_PENDING_PLAN_CHANGE_APPROVAL state. This method is invoked by the provider to reject the plan change on the entitlement resource.

operation.summary: Requests suspension of an active Entitlement.
operation.description: Requests suspension of an active Entitlement. This is not yet supported.
